config.accession_policy: always null for edgar_corpus - no reliable accession linkage exists
config.cik_type: int64 (python int, cast from source VARCHAR)

company_name_policy.match_key: cik only - no accession/period join (EDGAR-CORPUS carries no accession)
company_name_policy.missing_value_policy: null - never fabricated, never guessed from filename/ticker heuristics
company_name_policy.policy_decision: user-approved 2026-09-12: nullable company, over drop-field/scope-restriction alternatives
company_name_policy.tie_break_on_multiple_names: row with maximum `filed` (YYYYMMDD string, lexicographically well-ordered)

config.document_id_policy: reuse EDGAR-CORPUS filename verbatim (e.g. 1005817_2016.htm) - never row number, array position, UUID, or invented accession
config.empty_document_policy: a filing where all 20 section_* columns are null/empty/whitespace-only is written as a frontmatter-only document (empty body, zero Item headings) - the general programmatic form of Task 1.2's hand-curated KNOWN_EMPTY_BODY_DOCUMENT_IDS allowlist
config.empty_section_policy: null/empty/whitespace-only section omitted entirely - no heading, no body - unchanged from Task 1.2
config.fiscal_year_type: int32 (python int, cast from source VARCHAR)
config.newline_policy: CRLF/CR -> LF; exactly one trailing newline; UTF-8
config.output_filename_policy: extension replaced only, 1:1 - unchanged from Task 1.2 (src.normalize.edgar_markdown.output_filename)
config.processing_order_policy: deterministic stratified pilot sample first (Stage 6), then ascending sorted document_id for the remainder
config.section_ordering_policy: fixed SEC Item order, taken directly from source parquet column order - unchanged from Task 1.2
